$desc: This file contains the english language assets to make localization (relatively) easy in the future. Note that template string follow the format $xxxxxx where x is the xth format template parameter. So for example, 'I like my $000000 $111111 with $222222'{'green', 'eggs', 'ham'} would result in 'I like my green eggs with ham'
